verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee returns HTML by default, and its documented `return_page_markdown` parameter switches the response to markdown. That covers two of the named formats as the product's own selectable outputs. The evidence shows no plain-text or frontmatter output option and no general format selector. missing for 10: plain-text output option, frontmatter output option, a unified format-selection parameter, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can choose exactly which output format is returned, such as markdown, HTML, text, or frontmatter

citations.quote: return_page_markdown [boolean] (false) Return the page content in markdown format
Our headless browsers will wait for the CSS / Xpath selector passed in the parameter before returning the HTML.
